deliverables.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high fidelity visual proposal for a real cross-platform Flutter app named "morsecq", a Morse trainer and peer to peer Morse messenger. Create ONE exceptionally polished large landscape design board, about 2560x1600, with a desktop app screen on the left and a complete phone app screen on the right, on a very pale neutral presentation background. Flat front-facing screenshots, no perspective, no hands, no photoreal hardware. Board header exactly "A · 清爽现代", small subtitle "morsecq / 界面风格提案". This is a coherent MODERN QUIET design style: near-white #F6F9F8 backgrounds, white surfaces, deep charcoal #17352F readable text, restrained rich teal #147D68 for actions, pale mint #E5F2EC selection, fine gray-green strokes. Restrained shadows, differentiated corners (large panels 16px, buttons 10px, chips 6px), spacious crisp sans Chinese text. Precise aligned grid, beautiful and believable production product UI. No gradients. Desktop screen: narrow 84px vertical navigation rail containing five distinct simple icons and Chinese labels exactly "学习", "聊天", "群组", "参考", "我", learning active. Subtle morsecq wordmark. Content title "学习"; secondary line "Koch 课程、发报练习与听抄练习". Header small appearance palette icon labeled "外观". Large upper main learning panel with short eyebrow "KOCH 课程", large "第 4 课", small "共 42 课", simple modest lesson progress bar, subtitle "已学 5 个字符". Five small equal inline character tiles "K", "M", "R", "S", "U" with U clearly active and accurate Morse below each K "-.-", M "--", R ".-.", S "...", U "..-"; subtitle "本课新字符：U". Strong teal solid button "继续课程" inside the panel, full width enough for a comfortable target. Below, two horizontally aligned action panels with small line icons and text "听抄练习" and "发报练习", one quieter row "复习到期字符" and "暂无待复习". Right content column contains "今日目标", large "27 / 30 字符", a small teal progress ring "90%", and "连续练习 6 天", plus a restrained compact character review area using only already shown characters. All primary content occupies the upper two-thirds of the desktop window; intentional whitespace without being empty. Phone screen: matching style but show CHAT with header "陈亮", small green status "在线", back chevron and play-settings icon. Three readable message bubbles containing Morse plus decoded text: incoming "CQ" with "-.-. --.-"; outgoing "QSL" with "--.- ... .-.."; incoming "73" with "--... ...--". Every bubble has a small labeled audio play control, times "09:15", "09:17", "09:22". Light neutral incoming bubbles and solid pale mint outgoing bubbles, dark legible texts. Spacious chat viewport. Composer near bottom segmented selector "键盘", "直键", "双桨"; keyboard selected, text input "输入消息", teal send button. Show a draft input field without losing Morse controls. Complete device bounds visible. Need sophisticated layout and high typography quality, exact short Chinese labels, no unreadable lorem ipsum, no fabricated server or signal strength metrics, no promotional illustration or decorative blobs. Do not confuse goal completion 90% with accuracy. Do not use 3 equal generic feature icon circles. Render the actual UI design clearly at large scale.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high fidelity visual proposal for the morsecq Flutter Morse code trainer and P2P Morse chat app. Create ONE exceptionally refined large landscape UI design board approximately 2560x1600, flat screenshots, desktop app on the left and complete phone app on the right, on a cool pale presentation background. Board title exactly "B · 夜航电台", subtitle "morsecq / 界面风格提案". The visual identity is a calm professional radio operator's instrument console, not a sci-fi game: charcoal navy #121A22 base, slightly lighter #1B2732 panels, off-white #E8EFF3 main text, highly readable muted #A9BBC6 secondary text, restrained turquoise #58D6BE action highlight with dark label text, amber #F1B662 only for current character and current lesson. Monospace Latin characters and Morse patterns, clean sans Chinese, 1px structural borders, small 6-10px corners, no giant pills, minimal glow, absolutely no scanlines behind text or gratuitous effects. Crisp deliberate information density, flat data panels. Desktop: an 84px nav rail with morsecq emblem and five simple icons with Chinese labels "学习", "聊天", "群组", "参考", "我", learning active. Header "学习", right small appearance icon labeled "外观". Upper section uses compact label "KOCH / 课程 04", large "第 4 课", small "共 42 课". A horizontal modest lesson progress indicator. Five tactile rectangular inline character cells: "K" "-.-", "M" "--", "R" ".-.", "S" "...", "U" "..-"; U highlighted amber, other cells soft navy with thin borders. "已学 5 个字符" and "本课新字符：U". Large turquoise button "继续课程" with dark text. Two secondary rectangular action rows "听抄练习" and "发报练习". Small muted "复习到期字符" with "暂无待复习". Right goal panel shows "今日目标", large "27 / 30 字符", a restrained segmented progress bar, "90%" clearly tied to goal completion, and "连续练习 6 天". Tiny Morse dot and dash emblem in header allowed; no fake network telemetry, signal spectrum, VU meter, bandwidth or SNR. Phone: same instrument style show a keying practice view "发报练习", back chevron. Three-way selector "直键", "Iambic A", "Iambic B" with Iambic B selected. Label "请发送", very large centered letters "US", correct Morse "..- ..." below. Label "译码", dark high-contrast inset decoded output "US", small "键控中：—" and "20 WPM" as practice display. Two VERY LARGE equal touch paddles in lower half, one labeled "点" with "." and one "划" with "—", turquoise outlines with subtly lighter panel fill and one highlighted amber as an active illustration. Comfortable thumb targets, not tiny controls. Hint "按住发报", bottom actions "重新开始" and "完成". Desktop UI must retain conventional responsive nav architecture. Complete phone view visible. Palette action contrast excellent. This must feel distinct from a mere dark recolor: compact labels, ruler-style rhythm accents only alongside decoded output, angular field geometry, high hierarchy and tactile controls. Avoid neon neon-purple, cyberpunk, gradients, 3D effects, glass blur, cartoon or fictitious features. Exact Chinese labels with crisp text.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high fidelity visual proposal for morsecq, an actual Flutter Morse training and P2P chat app. Create ONE beautiful large landscape design board approximately 2560x1600, a flat front-facing desktop app on the left and a full phone app on the right, shown on a muted pale neutral presentation board. Header exactly "C · 纸感手册", small subtitle "morsecq / 界面风格提案". Design identity: contemporary editorial field notebook for amateur radio, calm tactile PAPER AND INK, not the original rounded amber Material UI. Warm off-white #F3F0E7 canvas, lighter #FFFCF5 surfaces, near black espresso #302E27 text, restrained terracotta #A74631 for primary actions, thin taupe #D8D0BF ruling, muted forest #57684B status accent. Very subtle paper grain only on outer margins, never on text/control areas. Typography is crisp readable Chinese sans for body; editorial heading weight, small tasteful serif Latin morsecq wordmark, monospaced Morse patterns. Rectangular panels with 2-4px corners, section separators, thin ruled dividers and miniature lesson indexing. Flat controls, no shadows, no faux torn edges, no excessive texture, no gradient. Desktop shows 84px vertical navigation with five icons and Chinese labels "学习", "聊天", "群组", "参考", "我", learning selected using a restrained left terracotta stripe and soft peach background. Main header "学习" with short subtitle "Koch 课程、发报练习与听抄练习"; right header appearance icon and "外观". Learning section uses a publication-like big "第 4 课", with small "KOCH 课程 / 共 42 课" and fine line separator. Five inline large character blocks "K", "M", "R", "S", "U", exact Morse "-.-", "--", ".-.", "...", "..-" respectively beneath; U is terracotta accent. "已学 5 个字符", "本课新字符：U". Clear solid terracotta button "继续课程", white label. Next two wide ruled task rows "听抄练习" and "发报练习" with small black ink icons and chevrons. Small "复习到期字符" and "暂无待复习". An asymmetrically proportioned right sidebar "今日目标", large "27 / 30 字符", tiny fine progress bar labeled "90%", and "连续练习 6 天", all using organized notebook margins. No invented progress analytics. Phone displays SAME learning content recomposed vertically: title "学习", compact "第 4 课 / 共 42 课", 5 character chips in ONE row to avoid tall full-width character rows; "本课新字符：U", clear full-width "继续课程" action above screen midpoint, smaller goal row "今日目标 27 / 30" and "连续练习 6 天"; two compact task rows "听抄练习", "发报练习", a muted due review row, compact goal 90% indicator correctly meaning completion. At bottom five destinations "学习", "聊天", "群组", "参考", "我", with distinct simple icons, learning selected. Complete phone screen visible, no crop. Distinct editorial geometry and hierarchy, minimal confident product design rather than a beige copy of original Material. Exact readable short labels. Avoid brass/yellow primary, uniform rounded cards, fake paper art, stamps that hide text, decorative photos or marketing copy.
